case.pattern_description: An undocumented structuring pattern involving multiple online purchases executed within a short timeframe, each kept just under the $500 authorization threshold. This pattern affects customer accounts with high-value digital transactions and was discovered via Sentinel sweep near-threshold transaction monitoring.

case.summary: Case SEN-012 was opened on 2016-11-28 following a Sentinel sweep on card C12897-K1 held by customer C12897, triggered by a rapid sequence of online transactions kept just under the $500 threshold. The closed-case classifier scored the flagged transaction 3493541 at a fraud probability of 0.98 based on multiple independent risk signals. The episode comprises four transactions (3493524, 3493535, 3493537, 3493541) totaling $1,999.89 executed between 2016-11-28 01:34:22 and 2016-11-28 01:44:44. Because the probability reaches 0.98 and the exposure exceeds $1,000, recommended actions include BLOCK_CARD on route L1, CREATE_CASE automatically, and FILE_REPORT on route L2 under §3a.

sar.narrative: Customer C12897 utilizing card C12897-K1 was subjected to a fraud investigation following anomalous transactional activity. A series of four online purchases totaling $1,999.89 was executed on the account. The activity occurred on 2016-11-28 between 01:34:22 and 01:44:44. The transactions took place online with billing region attributes associated with region 299.0. The transactions utilized mobile safari generic device profiles including iOS Device | iOS 11.0.3 | mobile safari generic | 2208x1242, marking a new device for the card. The activity is highly suspicious due to rapid structuring just under the $500 threshold, representing 3.3x the card's median amount alongside prior confirmed fraud history. Connected entities include prior cases such as CC-5094, CC-1803, CC-0167, CC-2801, and CC-1312. Recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a formal case, and filing a regulatory report.
